compiled_state.title: GREEN: create ticket-wordlist.txt with adjectives and nouns
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Create plugins/dso/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt containing common English words suitable for human-readable ticket aliases.

Format:
- One word per line, lowercase, 3-6 characters only
- Adjective section first (no header)
- Separator line: '# NOUNS'
- Noun section follows separator

Requirements:
- >= 500 adjectives before the '# NOUNS' separator
- >= 500 nouns after the separator
- All words: lowercase ASCII a-z only, length 3-6 chars
- No proper nouns, no profanity, no ambiguous abbreviations
- Words should be common enough to be recognizable but distinct enough to reduce collision

Alias computation uses: adj_index = hash(uuid[0:4], 16) % adj_count; noun1_index = hash(uuid[4:8], 16) % noun_count; noun2_index = hash(uuid[8:12], 16) % noun_count

Verify: wc -l plugins/dso/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt outputs >= 1000
Story DD coverage: SC4
Retry budget: 1 attempt
